stays.name: Mosswood Ridge Cabin
stays.shortDescription: A warm timber hideaway framed by pine, stone, and open Highland sky.

reviews.author: Amelia Carter

reviews.author: Noah Bennett
reviews.comment: Thoughtful details, a genuinely useful kitchen, and a deck that was peaceful even in light rain.

stays.name: Heathland Eco House
stays.shortDescription: A low-impact family home with generous windows and a sheltered garden terrace.
stays.description: Heathland Eco House pairs a calm, contemporary interior with practical spaces for families and small groups. Reclaimed timber, simple natural fabrics, and a bright communal kitchen create an easy base for unhurried days outdoors.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Isla Morgan
reviews.comment: There was room for everyone without the house ever feeling impersonal or oversized.

reviews.author: Ethan Clarke
reviews.comment: The accessible layout worked well for our group, and the terrace stayed comfortable after sunset.

stays.name: Fjordline Canvas Camp
stays.shortDescription: A canvas suite for two with a private deck facing a broad waterside horizon.
stays.description: Fjordline Canvas Camp is an imagined seasonal retreat that combines the closeness of camping with a proper bed, private bathroom, and weatherproof lounge. The restrained interior keeps attention on the water and evening light.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: No open flames outside the provided stove

reviews.author: Sofia Lind
reviews.comment: We had the atmosphere of camping without sacrificing warmth, privacy, or a comfortable night's sleep.

reviews.author: Lucas Meyer
reviews.comment: The morning basket was excellent, and the deck made even a cloudy day feel special.

stays.name: Quietwater A-Frame
stays.shortDescription: A crisp A-frame with its own jetty, reading loft, and calm water views.
stays.description: Quietwater A-Frame is a fictional lakeside house arranged around a double-height window and compact wood stove. A small reading loft overlooks the main room, while the private jetty gives guests a peaceful place for coffee or a paddle.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Life jackets required when using kayaks

reviews.author: Grace Whitmore
reviews.comment: The loft was cozy, but the jetty at first light was the detail we will remember.

reviews.author: Daniel Price
reviews.comment: Everything needed for a relaxed weekend was close at hand, including well-kept paddling equipment.

stays.name: Cloudline Stone Retreat
stays.shortDescription: A refined stone retreat with a sauna and wide mountain-facing living room.
stays.description: Cloudline Stone Retreat is a fictional high-country home where rough stone walls meet warm oak and wool. The social spaces are generous, the bedrooms remain quiet, and a compact sauna offers a welcome finish after a day outside.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: No outdoor shoes beyond the entry room

reviews.author: Elena Rossi
reviews.comment: Beautifully balanced design, with enough comfort for long dinners and genuinely restful bedrooms.

reviews.author: Marcus Hall
reviews.comment: The sauna and fireplace made our winter stay effortless, and every room felt considered.

stays.name: Canopy Knot Treehouse
stays.shortDescription: An elevated hideaway with a circular window and a quiet breakfast balcony.
stays.description: Canopy Knot Treehouse is an imagined adults-only escape built around the feeling of being among the branches. Curved joinery, a compact shower room, and a sheltered balcony make the small footprint comfortable in every season.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Clara Vogel
reviews.comment: Small in the best way: every detail had a purpose and the balcony felt completely private.

reviews.author: Theo Janssen
reviews.comment: The circular window was lovely at dawn, and breakfast arrived exactly when promised.

stays.name: Fernwatch Cabin
stays.shortDescription: A compact woodland cabin with a wood stove and fern-lined outdoor shower.
stays.description: Fernwatch Cabin is a fictional, straightforward base for guests who prefer time outdoors to oversized interiors. The single bedroom is calm and uncluttered, while the covered porch and outdoor shower extend the usable space.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Maya Ellis
reviews.comment: Simple, spotless, and much more thoughtfully equipped than most small cabins we have visited.

reviews.author: Jonas Weber
reviews.comment: The porch stayed dry during steady rain, which made the compact space work very well.

stays.name: Cork Grove Earth Home
stays.shortDescription: A softly curved eco home with shaded courtyards and an outdoor dining kitchen.
stays.description: Cork Grove Earth Home is a fictional retreat shaped for warm, social days. Limewashed walls and cork finishes keep the rooms tactile and calm, while two shaded courtyards provide separate spaces for meals and afternoon rest.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: No glassware in the outdoor shower

reviews.author: Nina Duarte
reviews.comment: The two courtyards gave our group space to gather without feeling on top of one another.

reviews.author: Oliver Grant
reviews.comment: We cooked outside every evening and appreciated how cool and quiet the bedrooms remained.

stays.name: Amber Ridge Glamping
stays.shortDescription: A ridge-top bell tent with a private washroom and a deck for long sunsets.
stays.description: Amber Ridge Glamping is an imagined camp for couples who want open-air atmosphere with dependable comforts. The tent includes a proper mattress and compact heater, and its detached private washroom is only a few steps away.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Campfires only in the designated firepit

reviews.author: Petra Ionescu
reviews.comment: The tent was warmer than expected, and the private washroom made the experience genuinely comfortable.

reviews.author: Finn Coleman
reviews.comment: A quiet camp with a remarkable evening view and staff who communicated every detail clearly.

stays.name: Pine Mirror Lakeside Lodge
stays.shortDescription: A generous waterside lodge built for shared meals, paddling, and fireside evenings.
stays.description: Pine Mirror Lakeside Lodge is a fictional gathering place with four balanced bedrooms and a broad open-plan kitchen. Glass doors connect the dining room to a long deck, giving larger groups room to spread out without losing the communal feel.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Harriet Cole
reviews.comment: Our group could cook, talk, and relax together without the bedrooms picking up any noise.

reviews.author: Samuel Reid
reviews.comment: The gear room and shoreline access made arriving with children much easier than anticipated.

stays.name: Granite Hush Retreat
stays.shortDescription: A stone-and-timber mountain house with a sheltered hot tub and library wall.
stays.description: Granite Hush Retreat is a fictional mountain home designed around quiet shared rituals: cooking, reading, and soaking outside. Its bedrooms sit away from the living room, and the covered terrace remains usable in changing weather.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Rinse before using the hot tub

reviews.author: Leah Romero
reviews.comment: The covered hot tub worked beautifully in mist, and the library had something for every guest.

reviews.author: Arthur Bell
reviews.comment: A serene house with excellent sound separation between the social room and sleeping spaces.

stays.name: Owl Pine Treehouse
stays.shortDescription: A two-bedroom treetop home linked by a sheltered bridge and shared canopy deck.
stays.description: Owl Pine Treehouse is a fictional family-friendly stay made of two compact pods joined by a covered bridge. One pod holds the living space, while the second keeps the bedrooms calm after younger guests have gone to sleep.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Bianca Stan
reviews.comment: Our children loved the bridge, while we appreciated having a separate, quiet sleeping pod.

reviews.author: Henry Walsh
reviews.comment: The compact kitchen was well planned and the activity kit filled a rainy afternoon.

stays.name: Cedar Trail Cabin
stays.shortDescription: A practical cedar cabin with a mudroom, covered porch, and family-sized firepit.
stays.description: Cedar Trail Cabin is an imagined woodland base shaped around active days outside. A generous mudroom handles wet boots and backpacks, and the simple open kitchen makes it easy for families to settle in without ceremony.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Pets must remain on leash outdoors

reviews.author: Rachel Kim
reviews.comment: The mudroom solved the usual family clutter, and the porch was ideal for slow breakfasts.

reviews.author: Miguel Santos
reviews.comment: Our dog settled quickly, and the cabin had every practical item we needed for winter gear.

stays.name: Alpine Meadow Eco Home
stays.shortDescription: A timber eco home with meadow views, a bright studio, and flexible family rooms.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Tara Novak
reviews.comment: I could work quietly in the studio while the rest of the family used the main room.

reviews.author: Ben Foster
reviews.comment: The sliding panels were clever, and the kitchen was exceptionally comfortable for six people.

stays.name: Larchlight Glamping
stays.shortDescription: A timber-framed safari tent with a glass roof panel and compact private bathroom.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Close the roof shade before leaving

reviews.author: Chloe Martin
reviews.comment: The roof panel was magical at night, and the vestibule kept our sleeping area uncluttered.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Greco
reviews.comment: Comfortable bedding, reliable heat, and a breakfast that was simple but consistently fresh.

stays.name: Silver Reed Lake Hide
stays.shortDescription: A quiet lake hide with a sunken lounge and a reed-edge observation deck.

reviews.author: Kasia Zielinska
reviews.comment: The low lounge made the water feel incredibly close, even when the weather kept us indoors.

reviews.author: George Mills
reviews.comment: A peaceful, intelligently laid-out stay with particularly good equipment for watching birds.

stays.name: Snowmelt Mountain House
stays.shortDescription: A spacious alpine retreat with a sauna suite, chef's kitchen, and four calm bedrooms.
stays.description: Snowmelt Mountain House is a fictional premium retreat made for extended family stays and thoughtful group trips. The main room centers on a long stone hearth, while a separate wellness suite and reading room provide quieter places to recharge.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Madeleine Roux
reviews.comment: Every bedroom felt equally special, which avoided the usual negotiations on a group trip.

reviews.author: James Patel
reviews.comment: The kitchen handled ambitious dinners easily, and the separate wellness room stayed wonderfully quiet.

stays.name: Cedar Sky Treehouse
stays.shortDescription: A modern cedar treehouse with a suspended lounge net and rain-sheltered deck.

reviews.comment: Rain on the roof was soothing, and the covered deck meant we never felt confined.

reviews.author: Dylan Brooks
reviews.comment: The children claimed the reading net immediately, leaving the window lounge peaceful for us.

stays.name: Rainshadow Cabin
stays.shortDescription: A simple off-grid cabin for two with a covered cook porch and compact wood stove.
stays.description: Rainshadow Cabin is a fictional no-frills stay for guests who value solitude over extra technology. Solar lighting, a water-saving shower, and a well-organized cook porch cover the essentials while keeping the cabin intentionally modest.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Erin Wallace
reviews.comment: Basic but carefully maintained, with a cook porch that worked well through two wet evenings.

reviews.author: Cole Ramirez
reviews.comment: The lack of distractions was exactly the point, and the wood stove heated the room quickly.

stays.name: Basalt Horizon Eco Home
stays.shortDescription: A dark-timber eco home with geothermal warmth and an uninterrupted sky-facing lounge.
stays.description: Basalt Horizon Eco Home is a fictional compact house with a deliberately sheltered profile and a bright inward-facing courtyard. Dark exterior timber contrasts with pale interiors, while the main lounge is arranged for long views of the changing sky.

reviews.author: Freya Magnusson
reviews.comment: The courtyard felt protected and private, while the lounge still captured an enormous sense of space.

reviews.author: Owen Parker
reviews.comment: Warm, calm, and easy to manage, with clear instructions for every feature in the house.

stays.name: Aurora Veil Glamping
stays.shortDescription: An insulated dome suite with a heated floor and a private forest-side sauna.
stays.description: Aurora Veil Glamping is a fictional cold-season dome built for two. The transparent roof section sits above a proper upholstered bed, while a separate timber pod contains the bathroom and a small private sauna.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Remove snow boots in the entry pod

reviews.author: Aino Laine
reviews.comment: The heated floor changed everything, and the private sauna made returning indoors feel luxurious.

reviews.author: Maximilian Kruger
reviews.comment: A memorable winter stay with good privacy and very responsive temperature controls.

stays.name: Blue Hour Lakehouse
stays.shortDescription: A quiet lakehouse with a wood-fired sauna, sheltered dock, and generous family kitchen.
stays.description: Blue Hour Lakehouse is a fictional waterside home designed around an easy rhythm between sauna, dock, and kitchen. Three compact bedrooms leave more room for a generous communal space, and the sheltered dock includes built-in seating.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Emilia Koski
reviews.comment: The sequence from sauna to lake to dinner felt effortless, even with three generations together.

reviews.author: Patrick O'Neill
reviews.comment: Built-in dock seating was a small detail that kept everyone beside the water for hours.

stays.name: Eagle Pass Retreat
stays.shortDescription: A contemporary mountain retreat with a sunken hearth and dedicated gear workshop.
stays.description: Eagle Pass Retreat is a fictional group house built for guests who arrive with serious outdoor plans. A ventilated workshop stores and dries equipment, while the sunken hearth and long dining room give the evenings a relaxed social center.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Clean outdoor equipment in the gear room

reviews.author: Greta Hoffmann
reviews.comment: The gear workshop kept the beautiful interior organized after long, muddy days outside.

reviews.author: Callum Fraser
reviews.comment: A premium stay that justified its price through excellent space planning and flawless maintenance.

stays.name: Birch Crown Treehouse
stays.shortDescription: A light-filled birch treehouse with a window bench and cantilevered breakfast deck.

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 14 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.

reviews.author: Ingrid Solberg
reviews.comment: The window bench was large enough to linger on, and breakfast arrived hot and neatly packed.

reviews.author: Nathan Cooper
reviews.comment: Clever use of a small footprint, with a deck that felt stable, private, and beautifully positioned.

stays.name: Brackenbrook Cabin
stays.shortDescription: A charcoal timber cabin above a brook, with a copper roof and a bridge-like porch.

Copper canopy over the brook-facing porch
Built-in reading bench beside a brick hearth

reviews.author: Clara Hughes
reviews.comment: The covered porch let us listen to the brook through a rainy afternoon. Both bedrooms were quiet and the kitchen was thoughtfully stocked.

reviews.author: Evan Brooks
reviews.comment: A lovely cabin for four with excellent walking nearby. The final gravel approach needs slow driving, but the arrival instructions were clear.

stays.name: Limestone Courtyard House
stays.shortDescription: A pale limestone courtyard home wrapped around an olive tree, with deep shaded arches.

Deep limestone arches and natural limewash
Step-free entrance and generous shared dining room

reviews.author: Nina Kovac
reviews.comment: Our family spent every evening at the courtyard table. The shaded arches kept the house comfortable and the step-free arrival made unpacking simple.

reviews.author: Daniel Weber
reviews.comment: The kitchen was large enough for six people to cook together. We appreciated the clear accessibility information and the calm setting among the olive trees.

stays.name: Saffron Sky Yurt

highlights: Saffron canvas and a circular crown skylight
Stone tea terrace overlooking almond trees
Separate tiled bathroom pod with warm lighting

Remove shoes on the woven rugs

reviews.author: Maya Laurent
reviews.comment: Breakfast on the stone terrace was lovely and the skylight made the yurt feel airy. The separate bathroom was close and beautifully finished.

reviews.author: Sami Clarke
reviews.comment: An atmospheric place for a quiet couple of nights. The evenings cooled quickly, so we were glad of the heater and extra blankets.

stays.name: Stillfern Boathouse
stays.shortDescription: A converted-style ochre boathouse with green sliding doors, a long jetty, and a lakeside sauna.
stays.description: Stillfern Boathouse is a fictional lakeside home inspired by a traditional working boathouse, with ochre timber siding, bottle-green sliding doors, and a steep shingled roof. highlights: Ochre boathouse with bottle-green sliding doors
Double-height former boat bay with whitewashed beams
Long private jetty and a separate waterside sauna

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 21 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Follow the posted sauna heating instructions

reviews.author: Aino Lehto
reviews.comment: Opening the green doors to the lake every morning was a joy. The sauna was easy to use and the kayaks were in excellent condition.

reviews.author: Marcus Bell
reviews.comment: The big lounge felt light even on an overcast day. We liked that the bedrooms were quiet and separate from the shared room.

stays.name: Stonepine High Lodge
stays.shortDescription: A tall larch-and-stone lodge with staggered balconies, a vaulted lounge, and a panoramic sauna.
stays.description: Stonepine High Lodge is a fictional group retreat set among mountain pines, with a narrow stone tower, vertical larch cladding, and staggered sheltered balconies. highlights: Narrow stone tower and staggered larch balconies
Vaulted lounge with a suspended black fireplace
Glass-fronted sauna looking across the valley

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 30 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 14 days before arrival.
houseRules: Store outdoor equipment in the gear room

reviews.author: Sophie Keller
reviews.comment: A comfortable place for eight without feeling crowded. The gear room was practical and the sauna view made a lovely end to long walks.

reviews.author: Noah Fischer
reviews.comment: The fireplace and vaulted room were even better on a snowy evening. Clear access instructions and plenty of storage made our group stay smooth.

stays.name: Tui Branch Lookout
stays.shortDescription: A sculptural pod treehouse with curved cedar ribs, a circular viewing window, and a fern-facing bath deck.
stays.description: Tui Branch Lookout is a fictional canopy pod supported beside mature trees rather than cutting into their trunks. highlights: Curved cedar ribs around a sculptural black pod
Large circular window overlooking tree ferns
Screened canopy bath deck and curved bed alcove

stayInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 21 days before arrival; 50% refund up to 7 days before arrival.
houseRules: Keep the bath deck gate closed

reviews.author: Maia Thompson
reviews.comment: The round window framed the ferns like a painting. The bath deck felt wonderfully private and breakfast arrived exactly when arranged.

reviews.author: Lucas Hart
reviews.comment: A memorable design that was also comfortable to spend time in. We liked the reading chair, simple kitchen, and the birdsong in the morning.
